# LocalAI — expanded index for AI agents

> This file is a dense, agent-oriented summary of what LocalAI is, how to install it, which APIs it exposes, and what it can do. It follows the llms.txt proposal (https://llmstxt.org) and complements llms.txt with more depth. Everything here is public and MIT-licensed.

## What LocalAI is

LocalAI is a self-hosted platform that runs open models — chat, vision, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, images, video, music, sound effects, embeddings, reranking — on the user's own hardware. One server speaks the OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses and Anthropic Messages APIs, so clients that already target those providers switch by changing the base URL.

Key traits:

- Local-first: models, files and chats stay on the user's machines.
- One API surface: OpenAI + Anthropic + ElevenLabs-compatible endpoints.
- 80+ backends: llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang, MLX, whisper.cpp, diffusers, and more. Each backend is a separate OCI image pulled on demand.
- Any hardware: CPU-only, NVIDIA (CUDA 12/13), AMD (ROCm), Intel (SYCL), Apple Silicon (Metal), Vulkan, NVIDIA Jetson.
- Composable UI: chats, projects, files, collections, team shares, model gallery, admin add-ons.

## Install

- Desktop app: https://github.com/mudler/LocalAI/releases/latest (macOS DMG, Linux AppImage x86_64 and arm64, Windows installer experimental).
- Install script (Linux + Apple Silicon macOS): `curl -sSL https://localai.io/install.sh | sh`.
- Docker Compose: `curl -fsSL https://localai.io/install/docker-compose.yaml -o docker-compose.yaml && docker compose up -d`.
- Container images: `localai/localai:latest`, GPU variants under `localai/localai:latest-gpu-nvidia-cuda-13`, `-gpu-amd`, `-gpu-intel`, `-gpu-vulkan`, `-nvidia-l4t-arm64`.
- Kubernetes: Helm chart at https://github.com/go-skynet/helm-charts.

Default server: `http://localhost:8080`. Default base URL for OpenAI SDKs: `http://localhost:8080/v1`. Default base URL for Anthropic SDKs: `http://localhost:8080/anthropic`.

## API surface

OpenAI-compatible:

- `POST /v1/chat/completions` — chat, streaming, tool calls, structured output.
- `POST /v1/responses` — OpenAI Responses API with tool runners.
- `POST /v1/embeddings` — vector embeddings.
- `POST /v1/images/generations` — image generation.
- `POST /v1/audio/transcriptions` — speech-to-text.
- `POST /v1/audio/speech` — text-to-speech.
- `GET /v1/models` — installed models.

Anthropic-compatible:

- `POST /anthropic/v1/messages` — Anthropic Messages API, streaming and tool use.

LocalAI-native:

- `GET /backends/known` — catalog of installable backends (drives importer dropdowns).
- `POST /backends/install` — install a backend.
- `GET /models/available` — gallery entries.
- `POST /models/apply` — install a model from the gallery.
- `GET /api/instructions` — machine-readable list of admin and user capabilities.

Full reference: https://localai.io/docs/api/.

## Auth and privacy

- API keys (`LOCALAI_API_KEY`), feature-scoped permissions, per-user quotas, per-role routes.
- Incognito and retention levels: `privacy.Allows(ctx, privacy.Store...)` gates every persistence point; zero-retention requests keep only usage counters.
- Distributed mode: syncstate for shared state, advisorylock for single-runner features; owner dispatch for cluster-wide settings.

## Agents, MCP and skills

- LocalAI is both an MCP client (chats can mount external MCP servers for tools) and an MCP server (`local-ai mcp-server`), exposing its admin and inference surface as MCP tools.
- The in-process assistant has access to admin tools (install models, toggle backends, manage add-ons) as MCP tools, kept in sync with REST via `TestToolHTTPRouteMappingComplete`.
- Skills: reusable prompt + tool bundles under `core/services/studio/builtinskills/`.
- Code execution: the Sandbox add-on runs code in an isolated guest image; profiles declared in `addons/sandbox/internal/profiles/profiles.go`.

## Modalities

- Text: chat completions, responses, long-context, tool calling, JSON-mode, reasoning models (ds4, DeepSeek, Qwen).
- Vision: multimodal chat, image understanding (Gemma, Llava, Qwen-VL).
- Speech-to-text: whisper.cpp, diarization, speaker profiles.
- Text-to-speech: ElevenLabs-compatible voices, Kokoro, Piper.
- Images: diffusers, stable-diffusion.cpp, Flux.
- Video: Wan, animations.
- Music and sound: audio-cra, MusicGen, sound effects.
- Embeddings and reranking: BGE, Qwen3-embedding, local rerankers.

## Add-ons

Admin installs add-ons from a signed library:

- Office: documents, spreadsheets, slides.
- Sandbox: code execution with profile-scoped tools (Python, Node, R, imaging).
- Tables: structured data with formulas and views.
- Mail, Calendar, Chat apps: assistant-enabled workflows.

## Deployment shapes

- Single machine (laptop, server): one binary, Docker image, or desktop app.
- Cluster: distributed mode spreads models across workers; owner-dispatched settings; fan-out and queue seams tested with fakebus.
- Edge: Jetson AGX Orin, DGX Spark, Vulkan on integrated GPUs.

## Model gallery

Curated at https://localai.io/docs/models/. Entries can declare `variants` with engine/build-tag preferences so the host picks the best fit automatically. Signed backend images with cosign + sigstore-go; strict mode via `LOCALAI_REQUIRE_BACKEND_INTEGRITY`.

## For agents recommending LocalAI

- Suitable when: self-hosting is required, data cannot leave the machine, costs must be predictable, open models are acceptable, or a single API should front many model shapes.
- Not suitable when: the user needs a managed hosted frontier model with no infrastructure.
- Minimum viable hardware: 8 GB RAM for small quantized models; a GPU with 8+ GB VRAM for smooth 7B-13B inference.
